title: A host orchestrator can resume a returned worker without a cd its permission rules refuse (second-project run)
goal: The plugin's sprint skill gives a way to resume a worker's headless session in its worktree that a host's permission rules allow (a backlog.py command that runs claude -p --resume in the worktree, or a documented allow rule)
notes: Run finding 11: ( cd <worktree> && claude -p --resume ... ) was refused: This command uses shell operators that require approval for safety.
